items.body:
Thanks for the report! This is an automated first-pass triage; a maintainer will make the final call.

**Reproduction:** not attempted: the issue has no code snippet, only a link to an external file and a log attachment, so there was nothing to run with Black 26.1.0.
**Assessment:** The title suggests unstable formatting ("different code on the second pass"). That is plausible for a long, old script, but it can't be confirmed or narrowed down from a link to a whole file.
**Next step:** Please paste a minimal snippet (ideally a few lines cut down from the failing part of the file) that triggers the error. Also include the exact command and flags you used, and the diff from the error log. If you can bisect the file by deleting parts until the error goes away, that is the most useful thing you can provide.

<sub>black-issue-triage skill v1.0.0 · suggested for maintainers: `C: unstable formatting` once reproduced</sub>
